grammar.title: 语法知识 现在完成时态
lines: 现在完成 (过去发生，影响现在) 一般过去 (过去发生，无关现在)
He has got married. 他 已经 结婚了。 He got married in 2010. 他2010 年结的婚。
I have graduated . 我 已经 毕业了。 I graduated in 2006. 我2006 年毕业的。
I have finished Book1. 我 已经 学完一册了。 I finished Book1 last week. 我上周学完一册的。
I have been to New York. 我 去过 纽约。 I went to New York in 2010. 我2010年去了纽约。
我做过的事，与现在产生了关联 (持续状态) 只能告诉你我做过什么事 (瞬间状态)

sentences.title: 单词句型 动词的变化
lines: 3 现在完成 (引起话题) ↔ 一般过去 (具体谈论)
Have you met Mrs. Jones yet?
Yes. I have .
When did you meet her?
I met her two weeks ago.
Has the boss left yet? 引起话题
Yes, he has . 具体谈论
When did he leave ?
He left ten minutes ago.
Have you had breakfast yet?
Yes, we have .
When did you have it?
We had it at half past seven .
Has she found her pen yet?
Yes. she has .
When did she find it?
She found it an hour ago .

expand.title: 扩展知识 has / have been 或 has / have gone
lines: 3 每日习语 in hot water 陷入麻烦, 处境困难
Sam： Sally and Tim are on holiday, aren't they?
Where have they gone ?
Sue： To Florida, again.
Sam： How many times have they been there?
Sue： This is their third visit.
Harry: I saw you in Annabel's Restaurant last night.
Diana: No, it wasn't me.
I have never been there.
Alan: Where's Tony?
Mary: He's got a headache so he has gone to bed.
Steve: Can I speak to Jill, please?
Lynn: She's out, I'm afraid.
She has gone to the cinema this evening.
